content_units: Fast-Pick Comedy Lineup
You want smart, low-cringe ensemble comedies with short episodes and no laugh-track feel. Based on  Derry Girls ,  Brooklyn Nine-Nine , and  Only Murders in the Building , these 8 are the best fit.
Ranked 20–35 Minute Comedy Picks
Series   Episode Length   Why It Fits   Humor Style
The Other Two   22–30 min   Sharp ensemble, absurd showbiz setting, fast dialogue, surprisingly warm underneath   Acidic industry satire with affectionate character comedy
Abbott Elementary   22 min   Great group chemistry, quick pacing, heartfelt without getting saccharine   Dry observational humor and workplace banter
Party Down   25–30 min   Terrific ensemble of lovable strivers; consistently witty and low on forced awkwardness   Deadpan cynicism, social satire, character-based punchlines
Ghosts (UK)   28–30 min   Cozy ensemble chaos with clever recurring personalities and very little cringe   Light farce, British wit, gentle absurdity
This Way Up   25 min   Smart, emotionally grounded, funny without feeling broad or sitcom-y   Wry, intimate, slightly offbeat conversational humor
Stath Lets Flats   24 min   Ensemble-driven and delightfully weird, but not laugh-track broad   Surreal awkwardness, verbal oddity, understated chaos
Bad Sisters   30–35 min   More dark comedy than pure sitcom, but excellent chemistry and sharp plotting   Dry Irish black comedy with biting family banter
Trying   28–32 min   Warm ensemble energy, funny without embarrassment-heavy setups   Soft, witty relationship comedy with gentle emotional payoff
Option 1:   The Other Two     A showbiz comedy about two siblings overshadowed by their suddenly famous younger brother     Fastest wit-per-minute
View series
Option 2:   Abbott Elementary     Mockumentary workplace comedy with strong ensemble rhythm and very low cringe     Closest to Brooklyn Nine-Nine energy
View series
Option 3:   Party Down     Cater-waiters, failed actors, and nonstop deadpan social disasters     Best if you want sharper, more adult humor
View series
Option 4:   Ghosts (UK)     A woman sees the ghosts haunting her inherited country house; each one adds to the ensemble fun     Best cozy watch
View series
Option 5:   This Way Up     A smart, tender comedy about rebuilding life after a breakdown     Best if you want warmth with wit
View series
Option 6:   Stath Lets Flats     Socially chaotic letting agent comedy with a distinct comic voice     Best oddball pick
View series
Option 7:   Bad Sisters     Sisters covering up a murder plot with great chemistry and very dry humor     Best dark-comedy option
View series
Option 8:   Trying     A sweet, funny ensemble-driven relationship comedy with short episodes     Best comfort watch
View series
Best Matches for Your Taste
-   Most likely to click immediately:    Abbott Elementary
-   Best if you want the wit turned up:    The Other Two
-   Closest to the Irish warmth of Derry Girls:    Bad Sisters  or  This Way Up
-   Best ensemble comfort watch:    Ghosts (UK)
Quick Actions
Start with Abbott
Start with The Other Two
